marketSummary: Indian equities witnessed a sharp reversal on Friday, November 27, 2026, with the Nifty 50 sliding 277.30 points (-1.07%) to close at 25,607.20 and the Sensex declining 989.33 points (-1.17%) to 83,339.26, snapping a four-week winning streak. The broad sell-off was dragged down by heavyweight IT (-1.88%) and Financial Services (-1.33%) amid escalating crude oil prices surging towards $97/bbl. However, market breadth showed selective pockets of aggressive momentum: the Nifty India Defence index soared nearly 4% on reports of a proposed 20% capital outlay hike for FY28 and massive Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) clearances, while Metals held firm.
dailyFocus: Swing setups are heavily bifurcated: avoid chasing extended breakdowns in large-cap IT and high-beta banking names, while tracking multi-week cup-and-handle and base breakouts in Defence PSUs, shipbuilders, and select metals exhibiting high relative strength against index pullbacks.

Large contract conversion from ₹3.7 lakh crore cumulative AoN approvals

Relative strength leadership during benchmark corrections

Foreign portfolio rotation away from export IT into domestic cyclicals

news.headline: BEL Defies Market Crash as Top Nifty Gainer Amid ₹30,000 Crore QRSAM Order Pipeline
news.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited ended Friday, November 27, 2026, as the top gainer in the Nifty 50, rising 1.72%. The stock was buoyed by sectoral momentum and strong institutional visibility on a prospective ₹30,000 crore Quick Reaction Surface-to-Air Missile (QRSAM) programme award.
news.impact: Exhibits exceptional relative strength against an index drop of 1%, confirming buyer accumulation at key support levels.

news.headline: Bosch Fixes December 23 as Record Date for 1:5 Stock Split and 3:1 Bonus Issue
news.summary: Bosch Limited announced on November 27, 2026, that it has fixed December 23, 2026, as the record date for its proposed 1:5 stock split and 3:1 bonus issue, subject to shareholder approval. The twin corporate actions will expand one existing equity share into 20 shares.
news.impact: Introduces a powerful liquidity and sentiment catalyst heading into the December 23 record date, favorable for momentum continuation setups.

news.headline: Nifty Tumbles 277 Points Below 25,650 as Crude Spikes and Heavyweights Slump
news.summary: Indian benchmark indices suffered a sharp reversal on November 27, 2026, with the Nifty 50 dropping 1.07% to close at 25,607.20 and Sensex losing 989 points. Selling was concentrated in IT, automotive, and financial heavyweights, exacerbated by Brent crude testing $97 per barrel.
news.impact: Tests critical multi-week swing support near the 25,500-25,600 band; requires traders to tighten stops on long swing positions across benchmark index constituents.

news.headline: BEML Surges 17% to 52-Week High Leading Defence Sector Bull Run
news.summary: Shares of BEML climbed nearly 17% to a 52-week peak of ₹2,381 on November 27, 2026, on massive volume. Choice Institutional Equities noted strong forward revenue visibility of 28% for FY27 alongside heavy institutional buying across state-run heavy engineering suppliers.
news.impact: Classic volume-backed 52-week breakout establishing BEML as the current upside momentum leader in the capital equipment and defence space.

news.headline: HAL Surges 4% as Defence Ministry Seeks 20% Increase in FY28 Capital Outlay
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited shares gained over 4% on November 27, 2026, defying market weakness. Sentiment was driven by news that the Ministry of Defence is seeking a 20% increase in capital acquisition outlays for FY28 alongside progress on Tejas deliveries and Su-30MKI upgrade contracts.
news.impact: Triggers a high-volume base breakout from multi-week consolidation, making pullbacks to prior range highs key candidate retest zones for multi-week swing positioning.

news.headline: Trent Faces Passive Outflow Overhang Following Sensex Replacement by Shriram Finance
news.summary: BSE Index Services confirmed that Shriram Finance will replace Trent in the 30-share BSE Sensex effective December 21, 2026. While announced on November 20, active and passive institutional desks are actively rebalancing allocations, putting mild supply pressure on Trent into late November.
news.impact: Exclusion-driven supply creates persistent technical resistance near multi-week highs; pattern breakout setups require extra volume confirmation to clear institutional selling.

news.headline: CG Power Concludes Citigroup-Hosted Institutional Investor Meet
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions held scheduled group meetings with institutional investors on Friday, November 27, 2026, organized by Citigroup Global Markets India under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR. Discussions centered on power transformer capacity ramp-ups and semiconductor unit progress.
news.impact: Watch for analyst commentary and subsequent block accumulation patterns as the stock trades in a tight base below its 52-week highs.

news.headline: RBI Clears NSE to Launch Futures Contracts on Corporate Bond Indices
news.summary: The Reserve Bank of India granted regulatory approval on November 27, 2026, for the National Stock Exchange to introduce futures contracts linked to corporate bond indices. This clearance follows prior SEBI approval and provides market participants with standardized fixed-income risk-management instruments.
news.impact: Expands long-term exchange derivatives volume and depth, acting as a structural positive for exchange infrastructure names.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Rallies 4% with Marine PSUs on Broad Naval Order Visibility
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard advanced over 4% on November 27, 2026, matching strong upmoves in Mazagon Dock and Garden Reach Shipbuilders. Investor interest remains elevated following long-term ship-repair cluster expansions with DP World/Drydocks World and accelerated naval capital spending approvals.
news.impact: Forms an ascending base structure off key moving average support; a sustained follow-through candle above recent pivot highs confirms a multi-week continuation swing.

news.headline: Omnitech Engineering Locks 5% Upper Circuit on BrahMos Aerospace Development Order
news.summary: Omnitech Engineering received a development order from BrahMos Aerospace on November 26, 2026, to supply assemblies of metallic airframe components and canister subsystems. The stock jumped 5% to hit its upper circuit at ₹540.35 on November 27 as government initiatives broaden private missile manufacturing.
news.impact: Circuit-locked price action signals intense momentum in niche precision defence suppliers, presenting potential continuation gap-up setups on opening bells.

news.headline: Apar Industries Discloses Maharashtra GST Department Inspection Under Section 67
news.summary: Apar Industries informed exchanges that Maharashtra GST officials initiated an investigation visit under Section 67 of the CGST/MGST Act at its corporate office and manufacturing unit on November 26, 2026. The company stated it is fully cooperating and noted no operational impact.
news.impact: Presents short-term headline risk that could induce volatility or delay base breakouts until official clarification or closure is reported.
